segments.description: Wide establishing shot of a sun-drenched French country estate and garden gates as models arrive [[00:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C1qPNAanBvw&t=0)].
Medium close-up shot showcasing the Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet perfume bottle surrounded by fresh pink roses [[00:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C1qPNAanBvw&t=7)].
Medium tracking shot of models enjoying a sunny garden party, cycling, and playing lawn games [[00:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C1qPNAanBvw&t=16)].
Close-up action shot of models applying Dior summer makeup collection products, lip gloss, and eyeshadow [[00:29](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C1qPNAanBvw&t=29)].
Medium close-up shot of applying Dior Solar skincare serum and highlighting makeup outdoors [[00:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C1qPNAanBvw&t=36)].
Wide aerial twilight shot of the grand estate fading out as the summer beauty collection is showcased [[00:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C1qPNAanBvw&t=47)].
